tool.name: qrp-mcp
tool.description: Offline scanner for quantum-vulnerable cryptography in source code and configuration. It reports its own coverage - which files it read and which it could not, per file with reasons - and emits a CycloneDX CBOM. Runs locally via uvx (no code leaves the machine); free and open source. Aimed at post-quantum readiness and DORA/CBOM evidence.
